test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following is NOT one of the objectives of 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' initiative?

options.text: Cash transfer through DBT at the time of marriage of beneficiary girl
Ensuring survival & protection of the girl child
Ensuring education and participation of the girl child
Prevention of gender biased sex selective elimination

solution:
__
 
• The correct answer is **c****ash transfer through DBT at the time of marriage of beneficiary girl.**__
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The following** objectives** are intended to be attained by the **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Yojana:**
 
• Improve the **child-sex ratio**
 
• Ensure **women's empowerment **and **gender equality**
 
• Prevent **sex-selective** and **gender-biased exclusion**
 
• Ensure the girl child's **survival **and **safety**
 
• Encourage girls of the country to attend **school **and participate in** society**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 
 
• The** Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao (BBBP)** programme has been launched by the government of India in **2015** to address issues with **gender inequality** and **women's empowerment** in the nation.
 
• The phrase** "Save the girl child, educate the girl kid"** is the meaning behind the name of this initiative Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao.
 
• The programme mainly aims to increase the effectiveness of **welfare services for girls **and educate the public about** gender bias.**
 
• **Rs. 100 crore** ($13.5 million) in initial money was used to launch this programme.
